name: China-Garden
kurzbeschreibung: China-Garden in Tirol Discover the enchanting China-Garden in the heart of Tirol, where a touch of the Orient meets the Alpine charm.
beschreibung: The China-Garden in Innsbruck treats its guests to a delightful selection of regional and seasonal creations. The kitchen blends traditional Tyrolean recipes with creative touches, creating a unique culinary journey. The cozy interior invites visitors to linger, while courteous service ensures their well-being. A warm bowl of homemade Tyrolean dumpling soup is especially recommended after a long day of alpine hiking. Furthermore, the restaurant offers a carefully curated wine list featuring fine wines from South Tyrol and Austria.
